raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misdirected the search by instructing WebSurfer to find precomputed “sample standard deviations” on ScienceDirect instead of collecting the underlying counts of Reference Works by subdomain for Life Sciences and Health Sciences (2022) and then computing the SDs. ScienceDirect does not publish those SDs directly, so this led to irrelevant searches (e.g., methodological articles) and wasted effort, ultimately preventing the team from obtaining the needed data and calculating the difference.
